causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Extreme weather conditions in South Australia and Victoria resulted in record demand in those regions. On Wednesday in South Australia record demand of 3317 MW led to high-priced capacity being dispatched at AGL's Torrens Island power station.

intervals.quote: On Wednesday 28 January the spot price in South Australia reached the price cap of $10 000/MWh five times in total (for the 3 pm to 5 pm trading intervals).

peak_price.quote: On Wednesday 28 January the spot price in South Australia reached the price cap of $10 000/MWh five times in total (for the 3 pm to 5 pm trading intervals).

causes.label: demand
causes.quote: In Victoria record demand of 10 072 MW combined with the unplanned shutdown of a 200 MW Hazelwood unit saw the spot price reached $6035/MWh at 3.30 pm.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: At around 2 pm Hazelwood unit four tripped from full load, reducing the available generation capacity by 215 MW (the majority of this capacity was priced below zero).

intervals.quote: The spot price in Victoria on Wednesday 28 January exceeded $5000/MWh once, reaching $6036/MWh at 3.30 pm.

peak_price.quote: The spot price in Victoria on Wednesday 28 January exceeded $5000/MWh once, reaching $6036/MWh at 3.30 pm.

causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Demand in Victoria reached a new record of 10 445 MW and in South Australia demand was at near-record levels.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: An unplanned outage of transmission equipment in the Latrobe Valley from 1.30 am to 9 am constrained off significant quantities of low-priced generation in the Latrobe Valley causing the price to reach the cap for one hour from 8 am.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: On Thursday afternoon an unplanned outage of the Basslink interconnector occurred... At 2.00 pm the Basslink interconnector tripped, while exporting around 400 MW to Victoria. As a result energy prices were set to the price cap until 3.20 pm in both regions when load was able to be restored.
